subject: reasoning
question:
On folding the given die, which number will be opposite to the number 12?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a38ce1faa9aca4352ed1b3516e2f30f9712f34f8bd0fd7d4e6db5b2851057a8.png]
solution:
According to the given dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a7fbadab28438412f342dc0b83476f074c87b23d7b5ca95461a896ce99c84a4.png] 

Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.

**12 ⇔ 15;** 3 ⇔ 9; 6 ⇔ 18

Thus, number **15** will be opposite to the number 12.

Hence, the correct answer is **"15".**
